title: Economy rules
description: Money formulas shared by the strategic layer (AI faction funds, STR-092, STR-093) and Management (the player's PMC: fees per op booked at launch and plant income; no salaries, no FOB or vehicle upkeep; MGT-005, MGT-070, MGT-073).
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

incomeFormula.description: STR-092: income per held region and plant (per-POI-type income stays in data/poi.json)

squadUpkeep.description: STR-092: cost per squad per booking interval

salaryFormula.description: STR-092: AI faction salaries only (the player pays fees per op, recruitment tiers[].feePerOpUsd, MGT-005)

payIntervalHours.description: STR-092 / MGT-073: booking interval, design draft 24 (daily at 00:00)

fundsMode.description: STR-092 / SAI-014: hardLimit default, scoreTerm test option
